name: Tenocyclidine
summary: Tenocyclidine (TCP) is a dissociative anesthetic with psychostimulant effects. It was discovered by a team at Parke-Davis in the late 1950s. It is similar in effects to phencyclidine (PCP) but is considerably more potent. TCP has slightly different binding properties to PCP, with more affinity for the NMDA receptors, but less affinity for the sigma receptors.

pharmacology.text: TCP has slightly different binding properties to PCP, with more affinity for the NMDA receptors, but less affinity for the sigma receptors. Because of its high affinity for the PCP site of the NMDA receptor complex, the 3H radiolabelled form of TCP is widely used in research into NMDA receptors.

uses.text: Tenocyclidine (TCP) is a dissociative anesthetic with psychostimulant effects. Because of its high affinity for the PCP site of the NMDA receptor complex, the 3H radiolabelled form of TCP is widely used in research into NMDA receptors.

sideEffects.en: It is more potent than PCP. Like PCP, it can cause confusion, agitation, numbness, loss of coordination, raised blood pressure and psychosis, and large amounts can lead to seizures or coma.
sideEffects.zh: 它比PCP更強效。與PCP一樣，它可能造成意識混亂、躁動、麻木、協調喪失、血壓上升與精神病，大量使用可能導致癲癇發作或昏迷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它比PCP更强效。与PCP一样，它可能造成意识混乱、躁动、麻木、协调丧失、血压上升与精神病，大量使用可能导致癫痫发作或昏迷。

fact.en: It was discovered at Parke-Davis in the late 1950s, the same company that made PCP, and simply swaps PCP's benzene ring for a thiophene ring. A radioactive form of it is widely used to tag NMDA receptors in research.
fact.zh: 替諾環定在1950年代末由研發PCP的派德藥廠發現，它只是把PCP的苯環換成噻吩環。它的放射性標記版本被廣泛用於研究中標示NMDA受體。
fact.zhHans: 替诺环定在1950年代末由研发PCP的派德药厂发现，它只是把PCP的苯环换成噻吩环。它的放射性标记版本被广泛用于研究中标示NMDA受体。
